• Differentiate between karyokinesis and cytokinesis. [U] / [CO3]
  • Karyokinesis vs Cytokinesis

  • Cytokinesis: Division of the cytoplasm, resulting in separate daughter cells.

questions.question: Explain the different forms of chemical signaling in multicellular organisms. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the different forms of chemical signaling in multicellular organisms. [U] / [CO3]
  • Chemical Signaling Forms
  • a. Endocrine: Hormones released into bloodstream (e.g., insulin).
  • b. Paracrine: Local signaling (e.g., neurotransmitters).
  • c. Autocrine: Cell signals itself.
  • d. Juxtacrine: Signaling via direct cell-cell contact.
